prompt:

Header text verbatim: "en löpare". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "runner".
Scene: A single adult distance runner approaching a finish ribbon on a track, proper running shoes and natural anatomy, no readable bib number.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "löpare = runner; a person who runs.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Löparen närmar sig målet.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
